title: Etale unit cohomology and inhomogeneous cocycles
statement: For every field K, GaloisUnitsTwoCocycleClasses K [def-sc-galois-units-two-cocycle-classes], with the Krull topology on Gal(Ks/K) and discrete natural separable-closure unit coefficients [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology], is in bijection with H²(Spec(K)_et,G_m), the cohomological Brauer group [def-br]. This comparison uses continuous inhomogeneous cochains and does not use the homogeneous cochain model.

proof.text: Construct the two directional embeddings by the stalk/derived-invariants comparison. These obligations assert injectivity separately, without surjectivity or a chosen equivalence.
Schroeder-Bernstein combines the two embeddings into a type equivalence. Compose it with the inverse of the existing homogeneous-to-inhomogeneous cocycle equivalence.

The library has no explicit continuous two-cocycle quotient. Existing discreteContinuousCohomologyFunctor requires a finite coefficient ring, excluding integers.
